text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm getting closer—another step forward in perfecting the winning equation!
choice_data_list: Gotta keep your eye on the prize, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Really, though, I should also be congratulating you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This victory belongs to the both of us. We're chasing this dream together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I plan to prove the superiority of my logical approach in the next race too! After which…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We'll celebrate our victory together once more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, I suppose I mustn't get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pride comes before the fall, as they say. One should always take stock of what mistakes were made and learn for the next time around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: On that note… Were there any errors with my opening… or my last spurt? I feel like I could spend all day combing through my performance.
choice_data_list: Why don't we review it together real quick?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Perfect! And thank you for making sure I don't rest on my laurels.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to have you in my corner.
